rule: Every scenario names the exact injection, the invariants it must keep and the tests that execute it. executed_by entries are HOST_SUITE ids (HOST:<id>) or JUnit ids (pkg.Class#method); tools/r31/verification_receipt.py --check-manifest refuses an id that does not exist. HOST is native SQLite, never ART; the android column stays NOT_RUN until r31-verification.yml instrumentation actually runs it.

invariants.NO_DUPLICATE_OWNER_COMMIT: r31_commit_receipt and every owner artifact are unique per task/owner/fence/chunk; a superseded owner lands nothing
invariants.NO_DUPLICATE_SETTLEMENT: a frozen prediction is settled once; settled_at never moves on re-entry
invariants.NO_OUT_OF_RANGE_PREDICTION: position and numbers in 1..10, distinct, probabilities present, hit in {-2,-1,0,1}
invariants.NO_PROTECTED_ASSET_DELETION: draws, certificates, frozen predictions, mainline choice and its legacy projection are never deleted by GC, retry or migration
invariants.RESUME_EQUALS_UNINTERRUPTED: after a kill the resumed run reaches the state of the uninterrupted run with no step applied twice

scenarios.fault: two owners on two connections commit concurrently through the sole writer
scenarios.injection: R31FullChainFaultHost.contention: 2 threads x 24 owned commits; SQLite busy_timeout; DatabaseCoordinator static writer lock

scenarios.fault: JVM halt (no finally, no commit) immediately before a native COMMIT / at every upgrade cut point
scenarios.injection: R31FullChainFaultHost child JVM halts before commit k in {1,3,6,10,14,18,22}; upgrade_matrix halts at every durable cut point

scenarios.fault: an owner superseded by the production fenced retry keeps running
scenarios.injection: R31FullChainFaultHost.staleLateCommit: ResearchPoolR27.retry then requireFence with the old claim

scenarios.fault: SQLITE_FULL at commit / usable space below the upgrade floor
scenarios.injection: GC commit throws 'database or disk is full' before COMMIT; upgrade DiskProbe returns 1 byte

scenarios.fault: later draws arrive before earlier ones; settlement re-entered
scenarios.injection: R31FullChainFaultHost.settlement: targets 4,3 then 1,2; injected failed settlement commit; two extra passes

scenarios.fault: 24h wall/elapsed clock jump while tasks are quarantined
one chart panel times out or fails while the page loads
scenarios.injection: R31ChartRegistryTest: one blocked panel exceeds its budget while the others load in budget; R31ChartPageHost: oversized/broken/wrong-ABI frames and a draw-input read failure stay isolated to their panel
verify_memory resume mode; verify_continuation slice kill/resume

scenarios.fault: a commit prepared under an old fence arrives after takeover
scenarios.injection: R31FullChainFaultHost.staleLateCommit late INSERT with the superseded claim

scenarios.fault: a research result is consumed again after a restart; a late label arrives
scenarios.injection: R31FullChainFaultHost.productConsumption two rounds plus every kill/resume

combinations.B01+B02: owner claim/fence + immutable write protocol (F01, F03, F09)
combinations.B03+feedback: settlement with out-of-order draws and failed commit (F05, F02)
combinations.shared: all four run on one database file and one source commit in R31FullChainFaultHost; the process-death cases reopen that same file
